userStories.title: Add required reason discriminator to PushUndeliveredEventDetail and wire the existing exhaustion site
userStories.description: As the operator reading the event log, I need every push-undelivered event to carry a required reason discriminator so that the retries-exhausted mode is never conflated with the pane-not-idle mode the next story introduces.
acceptanceCriteria: PushUndeliveredEventDetail (src/supervisor/events.ts) gains a REQUIRED field `reason: 'retries-exhausted' | 'pane-not-idle'`. [oracle: file-assert sed -n '/interface PushUndeliveredEventDetail/,/^}/p' src/supervisor/events.ts | grep -q "reason"]

The field is NOT optional: the same extracted interface block must not contain `reason?`. [oracle: file-assert ! (sed -n '/interface PushUndeliveredEventDetail/,/^}/p' src/supervisor/events.ts | grep -q 'reason?')]
Both string literal variants appear in src/supervisor/events.ts. [oracle: file-assert grep -q "'pane-not-idle'" src/supervisor/events.ts && grep -q "'retries-exhausted'" src/supervisor/events.ts]
The interface doc comment defines BOTH values (what each mode means for delivery certainty), not just the pre-existing one. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The single existing emit site (src/tmux/dispatch.ts, the `logEvent?.('push-undelivered', ...)` call) passes `reason: 'retries-exhausted'`; the intended compile break is resolved by passing the value, never by weakening the type to optional. [oracle: file-assert grep -q "retries-exhausted" src/tmux/dispatch.ts]

Every other constructor of this detail shape is swept, not just the dispatch site: the existing assertion in test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts (the toEqual on the push-undelivered detail) and any detail literals in test/dispatch.test.ts, test/issue.test.ts, test/supervisor/notify-orchestrator.test.ts are updated to the new shape. [oracle: bun test]

The existing test at test/dispatch.test.ts:435 ('geometry never returns to baseline: retries up to maxAttempts, then emits one push-undelivered event') additionally asserts reason === 'retries-exhausted'. [oracle: file-assert grep -q "retries-exhausted" test/dispatch.test.ts]
All 34 pre-existing tests in test/dispatch.test.ts still pass; none deleted, none weakened. [oracle: bun test test/dispatch.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/events.ts (interface at ~:528, WorkerEventKind union at ~:164 already lists 'push-undelivered' and needs no change), src/tmux/dispatch.ts (emit site ~:553), test/dispatch.test.ts, test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts, test/issue.test.ts, test/supervisor/notify-orchestrator.test.ts. This story is type-first on purpose: making `reason` REQUIRED forces every constructor to be swept, which is the CAM-363 decision-2 / CAM-364 decision-2 precedent against fixtures that model a shape unable to distinguish two modes. Do NOT take the path of least resistance (`reason?:`). At this story's end only 'retries-exhausted' is ever emitted; 'pane-not-idle' exists in the type and is wired by US-002. Do not change behavior here: no branch changes in sendKeysVerified. Grep scripts/cam/patterns.md and scripts/cam/pattern-records.jsonl for 'dispatch' / 'send-keys' / 'event' before coding.

userStories.title: Send exactly once and skip the verify/retry cycle when the idle gate times out
userStories.description: As the operator watching the orchestrator pane, I need a narration line to be delivered exactly once when the pane is busy so that I stop seeing the same [cam] line arrive three times.
acceptanceCriteria: When waitForIdlePane reports timedOut, sendKeysVerified performs EXACTLY ONE tmux send-keys and does not enter the verify/retry loop. A new unit test in test/dispatch.test.ts drives the timed-out state with an injected sleepFn plus the existing fake-clock idiom (pane content never idle) and asserts the tmuxSpawnFn recorded exactly one 'send-keys' invocation. Red on main: main sends 3 times. [oracle: bun test test/dispatch.test.ts]

In that same timed-out state, ZERO backoff sleeps occur (the recorded sleep sequence contains no computeBackoffMs-derived value) AND the geometry sampler is not consulted for a delivery verdict. Asserted as a criterion separate from the send-count so a fix that merely caps attempts at 1 while still verifying and sleeping does not pass. [oracle: bun test test/dispatch.test.ts]
In that same timed-out state, exactly ONE 'push-undelivered' event is emitted, with detail reason === 'pane-not-idle' and retriesExhausted === 1. [oracle: bun test test/dispatch.test.ts]
The existing stderr warning on the timed-out path is preserved. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Both reason literals are wired at the dispatch emit sites. [oracle: file-assert grep -q "pane-not-idle" src/tmux/dispatch.ts && grep -q "retries-exhausted" src/tmux/dispatch.ts]

Non-timeout path is untouched: the existing tests at test/dispatch.test.ts:369 (delivered on first attempt, no retry, no push-undelivered) and :435 (retries to maxAttempts, one push-undelivered, reason 'retries-exhausted') both still pass, along with all other pre-existing tests in that file; none deleted or weakened. [oracle: bun test test/dispatch.test.ts]

No CAM-361 timing entanglement: the two timing constants keep their current values. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS = 30_000' src/tmux/dispatch.ts && grep -q 'SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS = 50' src/tmux/dispatch.ts]

No async drift: sendKeysVerified and sendKeysWhenIdle both still declare a synchronous void return. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'export function sendKeysVerified(opts: SendKeysVerifiedOptions): void' src/tmux/dispatch.ts && ! grep -qi 'async function sendKeysVerified' src/tmux/dispatch.ts]

Honest docs: the dispatch.ts module header and the JSDoc for logEvent (~:160), maxAttempts (~:181) and sendKeysVerified (~:465) no longer describe push-undelivered as exclusively an exhaustion signal, and state plainly that on the pane-not-idle path the payload is sent once and its delivery is NOT verified (genuinely unknown, not confirmed). Verified by reading the diff, not grep alone. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

If src/tmux/dispatch.ts (605 lines on main) exceeds its file-size budget ceiling, the ceiling is raised in the same commit with a one-line justification naming this as an additive behavior fix; no unrelated code is deleted to stay under. [oracle: bun run check:all]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test), with a total pass count strictly greater than main's 5190 and no test removed. [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: File: src/tmux/dispatch.ts (idle gate ~:503, warning :504-509, retry loop :512-550, emit :552-554), test/dispatch.test.ts. Depends on US-001 for the reason type. GOTCHA (do not 'fix' this): the delivered-verdict polarity is counter-intuitive: geometryUnchanged === true means DELIVERED, because after send-keys+Enter the payload is submitted and the composer returns to its empty baseline; the wrap-collision case is geometry unchanged BUT cursor row blank. Read :529-539 and the header at :347-354 first. GOTCHA: the idle gate at :503 runs ONCE before the loop; do not restructure it into the loop. GOTCHA: every one of the 34 tests in test/dispatch.test.ts injects a fake sleepFn; two are structurally coupled to synchronous sleep semantics (the test at :389-430 uses sleepFn as a state mutator keyed on ms === SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS, and one around :310-345 stubs Date.now with a fake clock advanced only by sleepFn to exercise the 30s deadline without real waiting). REUSE that fake-clock idiom for the new tests; do not invent a new one and do not disturb either existing test. OUT OF SCOPE: CAM-361's 30s blocking window; do not retune IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS or SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS; do not make anything async; do not touch isOrchPaneIdle, geometryUnchanged, or cursorRowStartsWithPrompt; do not change maxAttempts/retryBaseMs/retryMaxMs/backoff; do not add dedup caching for the non-timeout path. Do NOT add a sleepFn/maxAttempts seam to src/supervisor/host.ts (makeNotifyOrchestrator ~:324-338): that is CAM-361 surface. Do not run a full casual `bun test` sweep while the sidecar is live (CPU contention has produced a false FIXES_PENDING); resolve test-count questions statically via git diff where possible.

userStories.title: Prove the pane-not-idle single-send against a real tmux pane
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I need the single-send behavior verified against a real tmux server rather than a fake spawn so that the fix is proven at the wire boundary where the defect was observed live.
acceptanceCriteria: A new test in test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts drives a REAL tmux pane that is NOT idle (a pane running a long-lived foreground command, so isOrchPaneIdle is false) and asserts sendKeysVerified issued exactly ONE send-keys call. [oracle: bun test test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts]
That same test asserts exactly one 'push-undelivered' event with reason 'pane-not-idle' and retriesExhausted === 1. [oracle: bun test test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts]

The test uses a real tmux server and real panes, never a fake spawn, matching the file's existing convention, and follows the existing test.skipIf(!tmuxAvailable) pattern used at :101/:134/:162. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'test.skipIf(!tmuxAvailable)' test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts]

The test passes an explicitly short idleTimeoutMs override so it never waits the 30s default, and completes within its declared per-test timeout. [oracle: bun test test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts]
The three pre-existing real-tmux tests in that file still pass unchanged in intent. [oracle: bun test test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts]

userStories.notes: File: test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts. Depends on US-002 (the behavior must exist). Reuse the file's existing scaffolding: bootPane, paneId(), makeSwapSocketSpawn(sendKeysCalls), the afterEach tmux kill-server, and the async body + `await waitForCondition` idiom (test/helpers/wait-for-condition.ts). waitForCondition is TEST-ONLY and rejects on timeout: never import it into src/. To make the pane genuinely non-idle, run a long-lived foreground command in it (rather than faking pane content) so isOrchPaneIdle observes real busy content. Per the project test-quality invariant, this must hit the real wire boundary; a mock-call-only assertion would be documentation, not verification. Do not run a full casual `bun test` sweep while the sidecar is live.
